new_quality_roles.control: Join only exact lossless UPRN text to the licensed lookup and report zero one or many Title_No matches; never force one-to-one.
Use Title_No plus Poly_ID plus Vers_No plus release epoch as identity; quarantine Changed or Deleted records until release reconciliation.
Keep freehold leasehold and other interests separate; do not promote pending registrations.
INSPIRE can provide an open freehold polygon candidate but absence does not mean unregistered and cannot exclude leasehold or other tenure.
National and INSPIRE index polygons and ordinary title plans represent indicative or general extent; label them registered-title polygon references, not exact legal parcels.
